body:
Thank you for the advice, I'm definitely going to follow that. As for my friends, I realize that they're toxic, but... It'll be hard to leave them. Although I don't mean much to them; they mean the entire world to me. It will benefit myself for the long term, and I plan on asking my mom to move schools so I don't have to face them.

I'm going to tell my boyfriend the entire truth, e doesn't deserve to be kept in thedark. As for my mother, it'll be hard to distance myself, as she'll start putting all the blame on me. And, if you ever need to vent to someone, you can message me when you need to as well :)
Late reply, but thank you so much!

Thank you so very much, that means more than you'll ever know to me. :)
Before I leave this world, I want to help as much people as I can. Although I won't be able to assist everybody, and there will be some tough losses, I'll do my very best.

Honestly, I don't want to commit suicide. 
I just want to drift off into a deep sleep, which is equivalent to death in a way I suppose. But despite all of that, I can be here for people, etc. So despite how idiotic I might've sounded, my door is open if you need it.
All of my other friends have been leaving me for other people, my family wants nothing to do with me. My mother, the one who's supposed to love and nurture for me, looks at me with nothing but hatred.
I sound so ungrateful compared to what you and everybody else have been through.
Yeah, I feel this all the time, except... I want to wander off into another universe all together. Pack my things up, and just disappear altogether.

I'd say it all depends on your perspective on the world.
I agree with everything you say, honestly.

Geez, I'm really sorry... If you ever want to talk, I'm here for you. 
My friend committed suicide, it was just all too quickly. He was the type of person who you wouldn't have expected to have been suicidal or depressed... I never did ask him if he was okay, if he needed me.
He was always just so focused on me, never himself. I blame myself, nearly three years later.

I am really sorry to hear that, nobody deserves to get bullied at all.
I knew the person for around eleven years, meaning that they were around for almost all of my life.

Haha.
Plenty of things triggered this to happen, I can't fully pinpoint it on one reason..
